To [Claimant][Defendant]['s solicitor] Malabu Oil & Gas Limited A company Incorporated under the Laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 35 Kingsway Road Ikoyi Lagos Nigeria

In the ADMIRALITY AND COMMERCIAL COURT

Claim No.

Claimant (including ref.) Defendant (including ref.)

Date

CL-2016-000631

The Federal Republic of Nigeria

Malabu Oil & Gas Limited

COURT OF HIGH 1S KEE

*

To the Defendant You have not replied to the claim form It is therefore ordered that you must pay the claimant the balance in the

chominated supreme court account (of $85,000,000 which at today's rate of exchange being 0.79 to one GBP converts to GBP equivalent of £66,619,087.05 together with any interest which has accrued on that amount) and £10,185 for costs forthwith.

If you ignore this order your goods may be removed and sold, or other enforcement proceedings may be taken against you. If this happens further costs will be added. If your circumstances change and you cannot pay, ask at the court office what you can do. Notes for the defendant
